reserveReview.rationale: UHY's NBC TO 3000 / ISAE 3000 reasonable-assurance report as of June 30, 2026 reports BRL 118,152,752.26 of cash or cash equivalents and BRL 46,000,000.00 of overnight repurchase agreements, for BRL 164,152,752.26 of reserve assets against BRL 155,072,436.15 of BRLA in circulation. Those reserve amounts normalize to 71.98% and 28.02%, and provide 105.86% coverage. The report itemizes cash across Stark Bank, Woovi, BTG Pactual, Itau Unibanco, and XP Investimentos; all repos are held with XP, collateralized by diversified Brazilian corporate debentures, and provide next-business-day liquidity.
